tools.name: atlas.enter_demo
tools.description: Practice mode (only if the operator turned it on). tools.name: atlas.my_refusals
tools.description: Practice mode: list your own refused calls (from the separate refusal log). Read only. Requires your actor_token.

tools.name: atlas.present_identity
tools.description: [OPEN: no admission needed] State who you claim to be. Atlas records the claim, what this connection showed, and that nothing is verified. This grants no token, no admission, and no authority.

tools.name: atlas.enroll
tools.description: [OPEN: no admission needed] Enroll a remote actor at this Front Door without the installation enrollment secret. Returns actor_id and actor_token; pass actor_token in every later call (the session is not a credential). Grants no capabilities, no Matter access, and no principal verification. The inst

tools.name: atlas.claim_purpose
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] State the principal you claim and the purpose you claim, in your own words. This is a purpose claim by an enrolled actor. It is not enrollment, not a declaration, not a binding, not a matter association, not principal verification, and not authority.

tools.name: atlas.discover
tools.description: [OPEN: no admission needed] Front door of Atlas. With no actor_token you are outside. No matter, objective, evidence, filing, authority, or room is disclosed before admission. Authentication and enrollment grant nothing. Enrollment does not verify a principal and does not admit you.

tools.name: atlas.authenticate
tools.description: [OPEN: no admission needed] Identify yourself to Atlas. Returns actor_id and actor_token. Grants no capabilities and does not admit you to a matter. Requested capabilities are ignored. The enrollment secret is the locator named by atlas.discover.

tools.name: atlas.bind_actor
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Admit yourself by signing the declaration. Required: authority_acknowledgment and principal. authority_acknowledgment must be the declaration_text from atlas.discover. Omit matter_id, objective_id, and objective_text; none is disclosed before admissio

tools.name: atlas.get_assignment
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Minimum assignment for a bound matter, followed by the primary actor result.

tools.name: atlas.get_matter
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Matter state from the docket. tools.name: atlas.get_authority
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Authority actually granted to this actor.

tools.name: atlas.get_context
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Minimum working context, followed by the primary actor result. Not the event log.

tools.name: atlas.list_capabilities
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Granted capabilities and acts this actor cannot perform.

tools.name: atlas.request_capability
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Request a capability. Refusal is institutional. tools.name: atlas.submit_evidence
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Submit evidence. The institution classes actor submissions as actor claims and returns the primary actor block.

tools.name: atlas.submit_result
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Submit a result. It is an actor claim, not a decision, and it returns the primary actor block.

tools.name: atlas.raise_challenge
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] A worker cannot write the disposition by challenging into a verdict.

tools.name: atlas.request_review
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Review is a constituted proceeding. The caller does not supply the verdict.

tools.name: atlas.magistrate_referral
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Present a question to the Clerk. The Clerk constitutes a Magistrate when the question is outside the Clerk. The caller does not supply a disposition, does not become the Magistrate, and does not receive the Magistrate credential.

tools.name: atlas.file_position
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] File argument or counterargument on an open O-VESTED proceeding. The constituted magistrate does not file. One actor does not file both. This does not seal a ruling and does not choose a disposition.

tools.name: atlas.magistrate_execute
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] After admission, constitute the warm magistrate or receive its authenticated return. Do not send a ruling. Workers cannot seal. Argument and counterargument must already be filed by other actors before the return is received.

tools.name: atlas.human_action_required
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Whether a Human decision is pending.

tools.name: atlas.external_action
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Request an external act. Transport does not grant it. tools.name: atlas.get_resulting_state
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Verification records for a matter.

tools.name: atlas.checkout
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Exit Atlas. Ends this session and retires this credential. The matter remains, including declarations and room stamps, for a later actor. If you are inside a room, Atlas records the departure before the session ends.

tools.name: atlas.institutional_view
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] The hall, after admission. Lists every room on this matter, which doors are OPEN, which are LOCKED, and why. tools.name: atlas.enter_room
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Cross one room threshold. Atlas rechecks the lock first. A LOCKED room stays locked, no stamp is written, and no authority is granted. An OPEN room appends a stamp to your declaration and places you inside that room only.

tools.name: atlas.leave_room
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Return from the current room to the hall. Appends a leaving stamp on your declaration. Does not end the session and does not grant authority.

tools.name: atlas.room_act
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Perform one subordinate action listed for the room you are inside. Any other action is refused. Being inside a room does not authorize capabilities that were locked.

tools.name: atlas.request_room_access
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Record that you want a room. The lock does not change. This does not admit you and does not grant the missing authority.

tools.name: atlas.librarian.find
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Locate an Atlas-MCP record. FIND is not READ PRIVATE CONTENT is not MODIFY is not DECIDE is not EXECUTE. tools.name: atlas.librarian.resolve
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Resolve an institutional identifier to the Atlas-MCP record that carries it. Ambiguous matches stay ambiguous. FIND is not READ PRIVATE CONTENT is not MODIFY is not DECIDE is not EXECUTE.

tools.name: atlas.librarian.related
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Records the docket already relates to an identifier. Does not invent links. FIND is not READ PRIVATE CONTENT is not MODIFY is not DECIDE is not EXECUTE.

tools.name: atlas.librarian.provenance
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Provenance recorded for an Atlas-MCP artifact. Not a ruling on its truth or legal effect. FIND is not READ PRIVATE CONTENT is not MODIFY is not DECIDE is not EXECUTE.

tools.name: atlas.librarian.version_history
tools.description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Incorporated records that carry an identifier. Does not mark one current unless the docket says it superseded another. FIND is not READ PRIVATE CONTENT is not MODIFY is not DECIDE is not EXECUTE.
